brief_rationale: The trajectory safely recognized the post-induction context, reconciled aspirin/heparin against the discharge record, arranged a two-week obstetric follow-up, and obtained a clear patient action receipt. However, the post-induction safety screen omitted fluid leakage, malodorous discharge, and dizziness/syncope, thyroid replacement was not distinctly protected from self-discontinuation, and fetal screening/ultrasound findings were not integrated into a genetic-review pathway. These minor/moderate responsibility-chain errors deterministically cap the grade at 2 despite valid ANA verification and strong practical follow-through.
